title: POST /stock/v1/inventory/search by guid and by multiLocationId answers MenuItemInventory rows, including IN_STOCK items with a null quantity

source.note: The guide describes the search body (guids and/or multiLocationIds), says every listed item comes back whatever its status, and defines quantity as the remaining count for QUANTITY items and null for the other two statuses; multiLocationId and versionId are described as reserved. The seed keeps the Lemonade at a QUANTITY and the 8.99 soup IN_STOCK under the multiLocationId the guide's example uses, 100000000171238879. The guide's two INVALID rows answer OUT_OF_STOCK and the literal string null for the identifiers they lack (one echoes the searched guid as versionId); the unit answers that shape since roadmap#56, and this case asserts the valid rows only.
